name: Toyota Caetano Portugal, S.A.
summary: Toyota Caetano Portugal, S.A. imports, assembles, and marketing of light and heavy vehicles. The company is involved in the import and marketing of industrial load handling equipment, and development projects for human resources, as well as the management of properties, including the leasing and rental of short or long-term vehicles. It also sells and rents industrial equipment, including counterweight forklifts and equipment warehouse; and offers business services and solutions. It distributes its products under the Toyota and Lexus brand names in Portugal, Germany, and the United Kingdom.
